title: EventData
description: The event calendar: which events exist, when they run (schedule), the in-game rotations and the Kingdom War cycle. The economy (items, packages, shops) is pack_data.json, which refers to events by id (`event_id`); shared definitions are referenced from pack_data.schema.json.

events.description: Registry of every toggleable "event" a package or exchange shop can be tied to via its `event_id` (whether or not it has its own exchange shop), giving it a display name.

event_rotations.description: In-game events that cycle through phases on a fixed clock (Survival Battle, Alliance Duel): which phase is on now and which comes next (core/schedule.js `rotationSlots`, shown on the Today page), and a chart of them on the Calendar (its hover cards list how to earn points). Keyed by the event's id; the Calendar and Today show them in this order (not sorted).

schedule.description: When each event (incl. in-game events), seasonal pass family and spend reward track ran: its runs as inclusive start/end dates, oldest first, recorded with `npm run record-run`. Feeds the timeline and forecast on the Calendar page.

description.description: A short line about the event (e.g. its bonus: "Warlock Hero DMG +50%"), shown below its name in the Calendar's hover card.

calendar_group.description: Show the event in this group of the Calendar's schedule instead of the one its category gives. `spend_rewards`: reward ladders that count something other than Banknotes (e.g. materials used on gear) and so aren't `spend_reward_tracks`. `alliance`: gameplay events you primarily play with your alliance (or can only play with it, e.g. by joining rallies).

eventRotation.description: An in-game event that runs through a fixed list of phases, `hours` each, from the start of the week: `week` names the phase of every slot, in order. The same week repeats every week.

week_starts.description: The weekday whose daily reset (02:00 UTC = 00:00 server time) starts the week, and so its first slot.

hours.description: Length of every slot in hours; `week` has 168 ÷ `hours` slots.

phases.description: The distinct phases (what each is called, looks like and earns points with); `week` says when each runs.

week.description: The phase (its `id`) of every slot of the week, starting with the first slot at the start of the week, or `null` for a slot without a phase (the Alliance Duel's Sunday). Not a plain loop: the sequence is as the game runs it, so list every slot.

kingdomWar.description: The Kingdom War: a cycle of war weeks and a break that repeats forever (core/kingdom-war.js, shown in the Calendar's Kingdom War box and on the Today page), the Royal City Scramble that runs every Saturday of it, and Origin of the Curse, which runs in its break weeks. A war week runs from its Monday's daily reset through its first `days` game days (until the end of Saturday); the Sundays around it are off.

cycle_start.description: The Monday (YYYY-MM-DD) on which a cycle started, i.e. the first war week (any past one: the cycle repeats every `weeks` weeks from it).

days.description: How many game days a war week lasts, from its Monday's reset (6: until the end of Saturday).

weeks.description: The weeks of the cycle, in order, from `cycle_start`: a war week (its `id` and name), or `null` for a break week.

royal_city_scramble.description: The Royal City Scramble: every week of the cycle (the break too), on `weekday`, from `start_hour` hours after that day's reset (= server time, as the reset is 00:00 server time) for `hours` hours.

origin_of_the_curse.description: Origin of the Curse: runs once in every break week of the cycle (a `null` in `weeks`) through a timeline of phases, from the first entry to the end of the break week (Sunday's end). Each entry's phase lasts until the next entry; a `phase` of `null` ends the event early. Times are server time (= time after the game day's reset).

timeline.description: Where each phase starts, in order of time, within the break week. A phase may come up more than once.

phase.description: The phase's id (one of `phases`), or null: the event is over.

time.description: HH:MM after the game day's reset (= server time).

image.description: The phase's own art (a banner in webapp/public/assets/events/, e.g. survival_battle_build_territory): the Today page shows it while the phase is on, the Calendar's chart as a thumbnail before its name. Without one, the event's own image.

earn_points.description: How to earn points in this phase. The Calendar's hover card lists them in this order, so put the Diamonds rule first.

pairs_with.description: A phase of another rotation in which the same action also counts for this one (Survival Battle's Build Territory and the Alliance Duel's Territory Development). The Calendar rings the slots of this phase that run while that phase is on. The other rotation's slots must be a multiple of this one's length, so a slot lies within one of them.

phase.description: The `id` of the phase in that rotation.

earnPoint.description: One way to earn points: the activity in the game's words (`text`, without the points) and the `points` it gives; `item_id` names the item the rule is about (the one consumed, or the one a bought pack contains), if there is one.

points.description: The points one such activity gives (per unit the text names).
